label: Second unde, real-otherness form: a nature actual through a really other esse receives it
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the weaker sibling of 89d82643, reading q.3 a.4's 'ad essentiam quae est aliud ab ipso' as real otherness. For every x: if x's nature is actual in x through esse, is other in content than being itself, and x's esse is not really identical with its essence (OWN_BEING_2 fails), then x's esse is received in its nature (RECEPTION_OF_ESSE_1). With real otherness of whatever is not esse tantum it gives back 89d82643 (compositionStepUnbundled). Suárez's profile satisfies it vacuously.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Real otherness of whatever is not esse tantum (NonOwnBeingsHaveRealOtherness), so that this sibling with the first unde and the nature in act gives CREATURE_1 reception. Its registered route is De ente stage (b): 860eae63 to a576300f (at most one actual being whose esse is its essence), plus a real-identity being that is esse tantum.
connection_plan.blocker: Stage (b) rests on 75b5b027 (any two beings whose esse is their essence share one nature), the open #697 individuation gap; Suárez's account of creatures, each really identical with its own existence without being esse tantum, denies it on OWN_BEING_2. Stage (b) shares 7fcfcee8 and 14325c83 with the reception cluster.
